title: ReCo-Splat
narration: ReCo-Splat reconstructs compact and expressive three-dimensional Gaussian maps from sparse, unposed images in a single forward pass.

title: Why compactness matters
narration: As more views are added, rendering quality saturates, while the number of predicted Gaussians continues to grow.

title: Inter-view overlap redundancy
narration: Red regions identify surfaces repeatedly explained by multiple views, which are the targets of inter-view compaction.

title: Scene-adaptive Gaussian allocation
narration: The model fuses geometry and appearance features, allocates primitives according to local complexity, and compresses cross-view redundancy through opacity competition.

title: Novel-view synthesis
narration: A compact representation still preserves stable textures, thin structures, and high-frequency details in novel views.

title: Geometry reconstruction
narration: Depth reconstruction retains sharper boundaries and produces more continuous local surfaces across challenging scenes.

title: NVS - Auditorium
narration: The auditorium sequence pairs the rendered view with predicted depth.

title: NVS - Family
narration: The Family scene preserves the sculpture and its surrounding context.

title: NVS - Real outdoor scene
narration: This outdoor sequence demonstrates stability in a cluttered real environment.

title: NVS - Real indoor scene
narration: A second real sequence covers a larger indoor structure.

title: Gaussian distributions in motion
narration: Along the same camera trajectory, DA3 and WorldMirror produce denser or less balanced distributions, while ReCo-Splat remains compact and follows the scene surfaces.

title: Intra-view Gaussian allocation
narration: Comparing the RGB reference, DA3, WorldMirror, and our result shows that the Gaussian budget is concentrated where appearance and geometry require more detail.

title: Render vs. Gaussian - Frame 0053
narration: The first frame reveals the Gaussian structure around the sculpture.

title: Render vs. Gaussian - Frame 0035
narration: The second frame preserves detailed indoor coverage.

title: Render vs. Gaussian - Frame 0083
narration: The third frame contains complex textures and boundaries.

title: Render vs. Gaussian - Frame 0124
narration: The fourth frame demonstrates compact coverage in a larger room.

title: Compactness at 255 Kpixels
narration: At two hundred fifty-five K pixels, ReCo-Splat uses about zero point eight million Gaussians and supports up to seventy input images.

title: Ablation study
narration: Ablations confirm that intra-view allocation and inter-view compaction jointly reduce active Gaussians while preserving rendering quality.

title: Compact, scalable, and expressive
narration: ReCo-Splat delivers strong capacity, stable geometry, and high-quality novel-view synthesis with significantly fewer Gaussian primitives.
